title: Replace sheet components with a library component
summary: Loads a component from a schematic or integrated library and swaps it in for the components on the current sheet at their old locations, with the editor notified of each removal and addition.
phrasings: swap a schematic part for a different library part
load a component from an IntLib and place it on a sheet
remove and add schematic objects safely
list the components on a schematic sheet

commands.name: ChangeSchComponent
commands.description: Replace every component on the current sheet with a library component
commands.params: LibRef=<name> (default Battery)|Library=<file name or full path of the .IntLib/.SchLib> (default Miscellaneous Devices.IntLib)|Loader=Library|FullPath|Any|NameNoType|NameWithType (default Library)|Max=<n> (default all)

commands.name: ListSheetComponents
commands.description: List the components on the current sheet
